title: Manhattan Christmas Tree
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 7 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1\leq N \leq 10^5; 0\leq x_i\leq 10^5; 0\leq y_i\leq 10^5; (x_i,y_i) \neq (x_j,y_j) if i\neq j.; 1\leq Q \leq 10^5; 0\leq a_i\leq 10^5; 0\leq b_i\leq 10^5; 1\leq K_i\leq N; All values in input are integers.
